coverTag: A concept for a social sanctuary in the heart of DIFC: a permanent collection with a living layer that renews itself for guests, residents and members.
headline: A social sanctuary in the heart of DIFC, with a collection people talk about.
opportunity: Janu Dubai brings Aman Group's more social, connected brand to the centre of Dubai's financial district, combining a hotel, branded residences and a members' club. That mix of guests, residents and members who return again and again calls for art that can evolve: a collection with a permanent core and a living layer that changes with the seasons and the calendar of the city.

concept.title: Golden Hours
concept.subtitle: Dutch light for a city of light
concept.statement: Golden Hours pairs a permanent collection of original works with a programme of Living Paintings: digital artworks that change with the time of day in the lounges and the members' club. A selected series is issued as limited digital editions with a blockchain certificate of authenticity, offered to members as a collectable, never as an investment.

email.subject: Golden Hours: an art concept for Janu Dubai
body: Congratulations on the plans for Janu Dubai in DIFC.

I'm Mariska Beenen of Gallery Dutch Art, an Amsterdam studio creating bespoke art and collections for hospitality. Inspired by Janu's blend of hotel, residences and members' club, we prepared a short concept, "Golden Hours": a permanent collection of original works with a living layer of digital Living Paintings that change through the day, plus a limited members' edition with a certificate of authenticity.
The concept is attached as a seven-page PDF. It is unsolicited and only a starting point; we would adapt it entirely to your brief and interiors.
Would you be open to a twenty-minute conversation in the coming weeks?

Warm regards,
Mariska Beenen
Gallery Dutch Art · Amsterdam
gallerydutchart@gmail.com · www.gallerydutchart.nl
If this isn't relevant, simply reply "no" and I won't follow up.
